title: Mega Man X4 · X
subtitle: PlayStation / Saturn · X campaign
intro: X’s weakness chain, all 16 permanent pickups, both arm-capsule options and the optional Ultimate Armor start.

stages.name: Web Spider
stages.tip: Charge the Buster while he is offscreen. Shoot when he drops, then dash away from the tracking web. In the rematch, Twin Slasher cuts his hanging thread.

items.name: Leg Parts
items.text: In Area 1, descend the waterfall and enter the opening behind the water on the right. Follow the short cave to the capsule.

items.name: Heart Tank
items.text: In Area 2, burn the brown tree trunks along the main path with your fire attack. The heart is inside the second burnable trunk.

stages.name: Split Mushroom
stages.tip: Hit him with Lightning Web as he clings to a wall. Repeat on the other side before he can fill the room with copies.

items.name: Heart Tank
items.need: Falling ceiling; Lightning Web as a backup
items.text: In Area 2, after the spiral staircase, trigger the falling ceiling, then quickly jump onto it and climb to the heart ledge above. If it falls too far, use a Lightning Web to gain height.

media.credit: Screenshot: Unknowni123 / MMKB; game imagery © Capcom
media.alt: Split Mushroom · Heart Tank — full scene

stages.name: Cyber Peacock
stages.tip: Keep Soul Body active and touch him with the duplicate as he materializes. Move while he vanishes to avoid the targeting cursors.

items.name: Heart Tank
items.text: In Area 1, finish timed room 1 quickly enough for S rank. The reward teleporter leads to the heart. Use Soul Body to clear the yellow orbs. An A rank advances without the reward; replay if needed.

media.credit: Screenshot: Unknowni123 / MMKB; game imagery © Capcom
media.alt: Cyber Peacock · Heart Tank — full scene

items.name: Sub Tank
items.text: Earn S rank in timed room 2 of Area 1. Enter the reward chamber and collect the tank before continuing. Keep Soul Body active through the obstacles.

media.credit: Screenshot: Unknowni123 / MMKB; game imagery © Capcom
media.alt: Cyber Peacock · Sub Tank — full scene

items.name: Head Parts
items.text: Finish the third timed room in Area 1 with S rank. Enter its reward chamber for the capsule.
items.extra: Uncharged special weapons use no energy; charged attacks still consume energy.

media.credit: Screenshot: Unknowni123 / MMKB; game imagery © Capcom
media.alt: Cyber Peacock · Head Parts — full scene

sprite.credit: Sprite image: Mamudo / MMKB; game imagery © Capcom

stages.name: Storm Owl
stages.tip: Lock onto him with Aiming Laser, then fire when he is vulnerable. Dash away when he dives to grab you.

items.name: Heart Tank
items.text: In Area 1, reach the platform beneath the giant laser cannon before it is destroyed. Dash over to grab the heart; use Eagle’s hover to escape. If the platform falls, retry the stage.

media.credit: Screenshot: Unknowni123 / MMKB; game imagery © Capcom
media.alt: Storm Owl · Heart Tank — full scene

items.name: Arm Parts
items.text: In Area 2, before the miniboss, stand to the right of the spike-lined shaft. Fire a web toward the left wall, dash-jump onto it and wall-jump above the spikes into the capsule room.
items.extra: Two alternatives: Stock Charge or Plasma. Both charge special weapons. You can revisit and swap; this is one armor slot, not two collectibles.

media.credit: Screenshot: Unknowni123 / MMKB; game imagery © Capcom
media.alt: Storm Owl · Arm Parts — full scene

sprite.credit: Sprite image: Unknowni123 / MMKB; game imagery © Capcom

stages.name: Magma Dragoon
stages.tip: Keep the Ride Armor through the lower lava tunnel to fight him inside it. After it breaks, use Double Cyclone and jump his fireballs.

items.name: Heart Tank
items.text: Near the start of Area 2, climb the high ledge to the left of the first enemy Ride Armor. Air-dash left to catch the wall; a Lightning Web can help.

media.credit: Screenshot: Unknowni123 / MMKB; game imagery © Capcom
media.alt: Magma Dragoon · Heart Tank — full scene

items.name: Body Parts
items.text: In Area 2, reach the upper-right ledge above the Ride Armor pickup. Jump out of the armor for height, then fire charged Twin Slasher into the blocking wall.
items.extra: Reduces damage and grants Nova Strike; recharge it by taking damage.

media.credit: Screenshot: Unknowni123 / MMKB; game imagery © Capcom

stages.name: Frost Walrus
stages.tip: Fire Rising Fire underneath him, then get clear of his slide. Melt the falling ice if it blocks your escape.

items.name: Heart Tank
items.text: Early in Area 1, take the lower path and melt the ice ceiling beneath the heart with your fire attack.

media.credit: Screenshot: Unknowni123 / MMKB; game imagery © Capcom
media.alt: Frost Walrus · Heart Tank — full scene

items.name: EX Tank
items.text: In Area 1’s slippery slope section, look for the high upper-right ledge above the spikes. Create a Lightning Web in the gap and wall-jump from it to the ledge.
items.extra: Raises the lives available after continuing; it does not refill health.

media.alt: Frost Walrus · EX Tank — full scene

items.name: Weapon Tank
items.text: In Area 2’s room full of ice blocks, break through the upper-right blocks to uncover the blue weapon tank.
items.extra: Stores spare weapon energy for later use. Refill route at the stage entrance →

stages.name: Jet Stingray
stages.tip: Jump close enough for Frost Tower to freeze him. Stay on the platform, evade his ground hunters and repeat when he recovers.

items.name: Heart Tank
items.text: In Area 1, do not jump at the third gap. Drop onto the lower platform holding the heart, then jump out before the next gap.

media.alt: Jet Stingray · Heart Tank — full scene

items.name: Sub Tank
items.text: Near the end of Area 2, jump onto the upper crate platform. Dash through the crates on the bike to collect the tank. Replay if you pass it.

stages.name: Slash Beast
stages.tip: Use Ground Hunter along the floor as he approaches. Jump his rush, turn and fire again while he recovers.

items.name: Heart Tank
items.text: In Area 2, take the Ride Armor through the train cars. Smash the red cars and check the second one for the heart on its exposed platform.

routes.name: Standard · X campaign
routes.subtitle: Eight-boss weakness chain
routes.description: Take Web Spider’s legs first; each boss reward answers the next boss.

steps.title: Spider → Mushroom → Peacock → Owl
steps.text: Get the legs, helmet and one of Owl’s arm upgrades.

steps.title: Dragoon → Walrus → Stingray → Beast
steps.text: After four bosses, X fights Colonel before continuing.

steps.title: Finish returns → Spaceport
steps.text: Return for Spider’s heart and Dragoon’s body capsule.

routes.name: Completionist · every pickup + armor options
routes.subtitle: Choose optional variants before New Game
routes.description: A normal X campaign has 16 permanent pickups. Ultimate Armor is an alternate coded start.

steps.title: Decide whether to use a secret start
steps.text: Enter the code before choosing your character if you want the variant. A normal clear does not require it.

steps.title: Collect every stage item
steps.text: All hearts, both Sub Tanks, Weapon Tank and EX Tank, plus all four armor slots. Wind up with either arm variant.

steps.title: Finish the campaign
steps.text: The other character’s campaign requires a separate new game.

extraSections:
Useful tips

Refills and preparation

Restock · Frost Walrus

Return to Snow Base after clearing it. At the start of Area 1, climb the walls to the upper path. Use Lightning Web (Web Spider): make a web near the high ledge and wall-jump from it. Follow it right for health capsules, weapon energy and an extra life.

Collect the capsules, use Pause → Exit, and re-enter to repeat until your tanks are stocked. Pick up health even when your life bar is full. Check the tank gauges before leaving; one pass need not fill everything.

Use your weapons after the helmet upgrade

Cyber Peacock’s Head Parts make uncharged special weapons free to fire. Use them freely against ordinary enemies; charged special attacks still consume energy and need Arm Parts.

Save health against Magma Dragoon

Keep the Raiden Ride Armor in Area 2. Take the lower lava route, smash the blocks, and bring it into Dragoon’s room. Fight from the armor for as long as it lasts, then continue on foot.

Ultimate Armor start

Ultimate Armor is an optional coded start. After the code, visit a Dr. Light capsule—Web Spider’s is earliest—to receive it. It replaces the normal armor hunt and grants repeatable Nova Strike.

Enter at character select, before starting. These are the original North American PlayStation inputs. Port, region and controller mappings can differ; the original Windows port uses different codes.

  1. Highlight X. Press Circle twice, then Left six times.
  2. Hold L1 + R2 and press Start to choose X. Keep them held into the opening stage; purple joints indicate the coded start.
  3. Complete the intro and visit Web Spider’s leg capsule. The capsule grants the entire Ultimate Armor.

Original Saturn: press B twice and Left six times, then hold L + R and press Start. Original 1997 Windows release: hold Down while selecting X. These Windows instructions are not the Steam Legacy Collection keyboard mapping.

Legacy Collection with an Xbox-layout controller, English game: B twice, Left six times, then hold LB + RT while confirming X. Keep the held buttons down into gameplay and verify the changed color. For the Japanese Rockman version the face-button input differs; use its version-specific reference. The regular pickup route works without a code.

⤢

Colonel & Final Weapon

After four Mavericks, X must fight Colonel. After all eight, revisit him at the Spaceport. Finish returns and refill tanks before the final stages.

  1. Colonel: jump the saber waves and attack after his teleport. Charged Buster shots are reliable; Frost Tower is an option at the later fight.
  2. Double: jump over his rushes and punish his recovery with charged Buster shots. Double Cyclone is his weakness but makes him more aggressive.
  3. General: climb by riding his fists, then hit the head from the side. Twin Slasher or charged shots work. Avoid dropping between the moving hands.
  4. Final Weapon rematches: reuse the eight stage weaknesses. Sigma’s cloaked first form requires Rising Fire; strike him from below when he appears low enough.
  5. Reaper Sigma: dodge the thrown scythe and attack his exposed head. Lightning Web hits his weakness; charged Buster shots also work. In the final multi-body fight, damage the exposed heads when they open, using charged Buster shots; avoid wasting attacks on closed armor.

basicsHtml:
Controls, tanks & returning to stages

Directions use actions rather than controller buttons: Jump, Dash, Fire and Special. Check your control mapping. Heart Tanks increase maximum health; Sub Tanks hold reserve health and are refilled by collecting health capsules. Exit from the pause menu works in cleared stages.

Restock at Frost Walrus before the fortress →

returnIntro: After the eight bosses, collect these planned returns. Also replay any stage where you missed a timed pickup; none of the ordinary stage items is permanently lost. Open a level to see its remaining cards together.

startHereHtml:
First time playing X4?

What to know before the route

X4 has separate X and Zero campaigns. This page follows X. You choose your hunter when starting a save and cannot switch during that campaign.

X already has a ground dash. His four armor parts work as you collect them; there is no requirement to finish the whole suit before using a part. Hearts and filled tanks help while you learn each stage.

Legs
Add air movement and hovering. Take the capsule in Web Spider’s stage early.
Arms
Choose one of two Buster upgrades. Both enable charged special weapons; their Buster shots differ.
Body
Reduce damage and add Nova Strike.
Head
Remove energy use for ordinary special-weapon shots. Charged attacks still use energy.

The Weapon Tank restores weapon energy. The EX Tank increases starting lives; it does not store health. Ultimate Armor is an optional alternate start explained below.

Heart Tanks increase maximum health. Fill Sub Tanks by collecting health while your life bar is full, then use them from the pause menu.
